knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A site record form shows what was requested, done, checked and paid for. It does not give discounts, replace insurance or hide costs.
Shortening the form to the fields its question needs, naming an owner and reviewing completion addresses the cause. Adding fields, lengthening the review cycle or relying on memory do not.
A national identity number is not needed for supply or roster records and adds privacy risk. The other options are false statements about forms or numbers.

practicalCriteria: A form register lists at least five forms, each with reference, version, owner, frequency and retention period.
One form is redesigned to four to six fields, each tied to a stated question.
No personal identifier is collected without a stated purpose.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80 per cent pass mark (all 3 of 3 correct for this lesson). A quiz pass is not verified practical competence. The form register and redesigned form are assessed separately by an assessor against the practical criteria.
evidenceRequired: Form register and redesigned form reviewed by an assessor
stopWorkCriteria: Stop using any form version that is not on the register as current.
Stop collecting any personal identifier that has no stated purpose.
